  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, presented the staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, to approve
  recommendation.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an update on the Norwalk Boulevard underground
project; announced that the traffic signal project will start in May; and provided an update on new
equipment purchased.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, announced that staff will comeback with an item to go over a summary
of the parade and carnival.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Del Rio thanked staff for carnival and parade.

Councilmember Roa thanked staff for parade and carnival, and extended gratitude to the car clubs

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula thanked staff for parade and carnival; and reported that he went to grant
seminar;

Mayor Farfan thanked staff for carnival and parade.

Councilmember Vargas commented on the parade and carnival.
